# Brett Goldstein

> Brett Goldstein runs Micro and Launch House Ventures, writes on X, LinkedIn and Homescreen, and makes music as Monte Del Monte.

This is a small personal homepage. The canonical URL is https://brettgoldstein.com/.

## Primary Pages

- [Homepage](https://brettgoldstein.com/): Short biographical homepage with links to Brett's companies, writing, music, and contact channels.
- [Writing](https://brettgoldstein.com/writing/): Archive for selected longer writing by Brett, mirrored from X.
